purpose: Define exact validation of canonical identities and all required references, including collision detection, active-source ambiguity and external-reference classification.

topics.name: Identity and Reference Validation
topics.purpose: Define exact validation of canonical identities and all required references, including collision detection, active-source ambiguity and external-reference classification.

semantics.identity_rule: Every required machine-significant node identity is present and exact.
semantics.reference_rule: Required internal refs resolve exactly once.
semantics.external_rule: External refs must be explicitly declared as external and follow their owning boundary contract.
semantics.history_rule: Historical/migration artifacts do not compete as active definitions.
semantics.diagnostic_rule: Every failed ref reports source identity, field/ref and attempted target.

invariants.rule: Validation proves or rejects conformance; it never invents missing semantics or becomes semantic owner.

hard_gates.condition: historical source competes with active definition
